note: Survey question wording below must match the IRB-approved text if that text differs. Responses are stored by participant code only.

pre.title: Before you start
pre.detail: About two minutes. This is not graded.

questions.label: I can do the main task in this exercise (0 = cannot do it, 100 = certain I can).
I feel anxious about this exercise (1 = not at all, 5 = very).
I expect to enjoy this exercise (1 = not at all, 5 = very).
What do you most want to be able to do by the end of this exercise?

mid.title: Check in
mid.detail: A short exit ticket while you work. This is not graded.

questions.label: I can do the main task in this exercise right now (0–100).
About how many minutes have you spent on this exercise?
What is the muddiest point so far?
Any technical problems? Leave blank if none.

post.title: Exit ticket
post.detail: After you finish. This is not graded.

questions.label: I can do the main task in this exercise (0–100).
I feel anxious about this kind of task (1 = not at all, 5 = very).
I enjoyed this exercise (1 = not at all, 5 = very).
What changed in how you see the outcrop, map, or model?
What could the virtual format not give you?
What would you do next if you were at the outcrop?
